Quantities come from your own numbers. Single vials have a 3-vial minimum; a 10-pack kit is cheaper per vial once you need several. Current prices are on the price list.

Formula: concentration (mcg/mL) = (vial mg × 1000) ÷ BAC mL. Units on a U-100 syringe = (amount in mcg ÷ concentration) × 100. Vials needed = total peptide ÷ vial size, rounded up. Nothing here is guidance — it is arithmetic on the values you supplied.
